verdict: Spend is running; zero leads recorded — the conversion path is being fixed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $502 was spent on Google Ads and 114 clicks came through, but zero leads were recorded across every channel. The findings confirm this is a broken conversion path, not a traffic problem — clicks are arriving and not being captured. Conversion tracking is being repaired and the end-to-end lead flow is being re-tested this period to close that gap. Your Google Business Profile, which drove 41 actions the prior period, also went quiet in the last 7 days; both issues are being worked in parallel. Once the tracking path is confirmed intact, the lead numbers will reflect the traffic that is already moving through.
